edges.reason: Lime stained glass marks the building entrance doorway; light gray panes are on an interior wall only visible after entering through the lime glass door
A 2-block-high gravel wall physically blocks the only path to the concrete powder storage area; player must mine through it to proceed
The concrete powder area is adjacent to the stone staircase leading to the elevated platform from which the lavafall becomes visible
The cave entrance ladder is at the base of the lavafall cliff; player must locate the lavafall to find the cave access point leading to diamond ore
The furnace for smelting raw_iron is inside the cave accessed at the base of the lavafall; player must find the lavafall area to locate cave entrance
Decorative polished granite stairs are railing elements on the elevated platform; player must reach the platform via the lavafall area to access them
Player must visit the dark oak grove (confirmed by shearing leaves) to obtain oak_log needed for crafting planks and then the pressure plate
